data.title: Waves Grande
data.about:
Introducing Waves Grande at Sobha Hartland. Exquisitely designed waterfront apartments in a gated community with incredible views of the city. 

Choose from 1 – 4 bedroom homes with interiors of the highest quality. These homes have views of the waterfront, Downtown Dubai, and Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. The amenities are divided into 3 levels with clear views of the park.

characteristics_module.title: Limited Edition 2 BR Options With Park Views
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Choose from stunning 1-4 BR waterfront apartments
  • 1 – 3 BR apartments have study room options
  • 13 duplex options including 4 bedrooms
  • Incredible views of Downtown Dubai, Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, Parks and Waterfront
  • Starting at AED 1.2 million
  • Pay 20% now and 80% on handover
  • Get 2 years waiver on service charge
  • Located in Sobha Hartland’s waterside district

location_tile.title: Waves Grande is located on an exclusive Waterfront District within the luxurious Sobha Hartland.
location_tile.description:
One of Dubai’s finest and most prime locations, Sobha Hartland is just minutes from the major landmarks of the city, like the Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, as well as many other leisure hubs. When you live in Sobha Hartland, you are surrounded by the best of everything.

  • 2 Minutes – International School
  • 5 Minutes – Meydan Racecourse, Country Club
  • 5 Minutes – Burj Khalifa,  Dubai Mall
  • 20 Minutes – Dubai Int’l Airport
  • 20 Minutes – Palm Jumeirah, Emirates Golf Club
